name: FANSHAWE'S OFFICE
note: EXTRACTED by tools/extract-examine.mjs from the documents its sources name -- errata 67's merge, in doc 05's, the batch's, then the repeats' order, less errata 68 H's drops. Do not edit: change the documents and re-run.

subjects.name: THE PORTRAIT
LOOK_AT: Colonel Fanshawe, painted at approximately twice life size and one-third his actual age.
The uniform has more braid than a regiment would issue and fewer stains than a war would allow.
The painter has given him a battle in the background. It is not clear which battle. I suspect the painter was told several.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Which is the first honest thing about it.
Canvas, stretched very taut, like the story.
Nothing. In oils he is the strong, silent type, which is the only thing the painter added.

overrides.TALK_TO: The painted one listens exactly as well and commits to less. I prefer him slightly.

subjects.name: THE SABRE
LOOK_AT: A cavalry sabre, mounted. Beautifully kept.
The scabbard is engraved with a battle honor. I would tell you which, but the engraving and the Colonel disagree.
Not a nick on it. It is either the finest blade in the territory or it has never met anything.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. It has never left this wall and it has never been sharpened.
Nothing. Steel at rest, and resting comfortably.
A faint ring when the door closes, and then it remembers itself.

subjects.name: THE CHAIRS
LOOK_AT: Eleven chairs, in a room that receives visitors one at a time.
Each one is turned slightly toward his desk, the way flowers turn toward a window.
Eleven chairs. I counted twice, and on the second count I had the strong impression I had been offered one.
LISTEN_TO: Leather, settling. They are extremely comfortable and I do not wish to sit in one.
A cushion slowly breathing out. Somebody sat in it recently and was relieved of something.
Nothing. Good furniture in this town is very patient.

overrides.PUSH: They are heavier than they look. Everything in this office is heavier than it looks.

subjects.name: THE MAP WALL
LOOK_AT: Every claim in the district, pinned. Two of them have red pins. One is Claim One. The other is mine.
Green pins for the Company, a great many. The two red pins are alone together near the middle.
My pin has been pushed all the way in. The others merely rest. I do not know why that bothers me as much as it does.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing.
Pins ticking against the cork in the draft. A small, busy, acquisitive sound.
Nothing. The map is entirely up to date and has nothing further to report.

subjects.name: THE DECANTER
LOOK_AT: Good whisky, offered freely to everyone, always.
Cut glass, and the whisky catches the light so well I suspect the light came with it.
He pours for every visitor and none for himself. A man who never drinks, in a room built for drinking, is a man keeping count.
LISTEN_TO: Full. It is always full. He does not drink it.
The stopper rings faintly when the desk is struck. Even the glass is in a cordial mood.
Nothing. It is full again. Somebody refills it quietly.

overrides.OPEN: It is always already open. Generosity, pre-loaded.

subjects.name: THE SUBMISSION LOG
LOOK_AT: The Company's submission log, bound in green leather, closed, and lying where he can reach it and I cannot.
He has moved it an inch since I last looked. He is a courteous man and a careful one, and in him those are not in tension.
The spine is cracked in one place only, where it is opened most. Whatever is in it is consulted daily.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. It is closed, and it will stay closed while he is in the room.
Nothing. Even the paper in this office waits to be invited.
Nothing. I have the distinct sense of the book listening back.

overrides.PICK_UP (empty office): Nine years of priority submissions, filed one day a month, every month, in one hand. Winnie is going to want to see this, and she is not going to enjoy it.
overrides.PICK_UP_or_OPEN (Fanshawe present): Not with him in the room. He would offer to help me carry it.

subjects.name: THE SAFE
LOOK_AT: A safe the size of a small cabin, painted with roses and a landscape, as though money could be made to feel at home.
The landscape has a river in it, running gold, toward the handle.
He has never opened it in front of me. He has opened everything else.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Iron this thick has heard nothing since it was cast.
Nothing. It does not tick, which is the first thing I listen for in a lock.
A dull note when the floor takes my weight. Heavy things have very little to say, and say it low.

subjects.name: THE WINDOW
LOOK_AT: A tall window over Main Street, curtained in velvet the color of good port. He can see the whole town from here, and the town can see him being generous.
The glass is new, thick, and very slightly green. The town looks prosperous through it. That may be what the glass is for.
From here you can see the Assay Office door and the Registrar's, and how long the line is at each.
LISTEN_TO: Main Street, with the edges taken off. Even the noise is muffled into good manners in this room.
A wagon passing. Through this glass it sounds as if it is paying a call.
Nothing gets in that he has not let in. The street knocks politely and is not answered.

subjects.name: THE STOCK PORTRAIT DRAWER
LOOK_AT: A wide, shallow drawer in the sideboard, the kind printers keep plates in. Fine joinery, for something nobody is meant to look in.
It does not quite close. A corner of card shows at the gap, the good heavy kind photographers use.
He has offered me everything else in this room. He has not offered me this.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Whatever is in there is packed too tight to shift.
The runners squeak a little when the sideboard takes my weight. It has been opened recently.
Nothing more. I am being very good.

overrides.OPEN_or_PICK_UP (empty office): The drawer is full of the same gentleman. Dozens of him, stacked, all looking nobly at nothing. Every one of him is Obadiah Mott.
overrides.PICK_UP_or_OPEN (Fanshawe present): Not with him in the room. He would offer to help me carry it.

subjects.name: THE HANDKERCHIEF
LOOK_AT: A handkerchief of white silk, monogrammed in thread finer than anything else in the territory.
He offers it to anyone who looks upset. Several men have left this office with one, and with nothing else.
The initials are A.F., the A rather larger than the F, as though the A had done most of the work.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. Silk is too well bred to rustle.
The faintest whisper of starch. Even his linen is persuasive.
Nothing at all. It is the softest thing in Consolation, and it has never once been used to wipe anything.

subjects.name: THE LEDGERS
LOOK_AT: Company ledgers, a shelf of them, in green morocco with gilt dates. Twelve years of accounts, bound handsomely enough to be believed.
The spines are all one thickness, year after year. Business in Consolation, it appears, never rises and never falls. It merely continues.
He has offered to let me read them, and I believe he would. That is how I know there is nothing in them.
LISTEN_TO: Nothing. A shelf of figures that all agree with each other.
The shelf creaks under them. They are heavier than the business they describe.
Nothing. The particular quiet of a book that has never been audited.

subjects.name: THE DOOR
LOOK_AT: From this side it is a door like any other. From the lobby it is the most important door in the territory. He has arranged both.
The hinges are oiled so that it closes without a sound. Visitors find themselves inside before they have decided to come in.
There is no lock on this side. There has never been any need. Nobody leaves this office in a hurry.
LISTEN_TO: The lobby, faintly, and the clock out there being eleven minutes wrong.
Nothing. A door this well hung keeps every secret in the room and lets in only the draft.
Voices in the lobby, waiting. Everyone waits out there. Nobody waits in here.

COLONEL FANSHAWE.PICK_UP: He would allow it. He would find it delightful. That is the reason not to.
COLONEL FANSHAWE.PUSH: He would step aside before I touched him, and thank me, and I would be further in than I was.
COLONEL FANSHAWE.GIVE: Whatever I give him, he gives back something nicer. I have stopped giving him things.
COLONEL FANSHAWE.USE: He is the one who uses. It is not a position open to applicants.
